verdict: Organic engagement is holding; paid channels and key milestones remain offline.
narrative: Across all three businesses this period, Google Business Profile was the only active channel, combining for 431 total actions — 12 calls, 313 direction requests, and 106 website clicks — over 28 days. Paid advertising ran at zero spend on both Meta and Google Ads, meaning no leads were generated through paid channels this period. Organic signals softened week over week at Forte and O'Hare, while Advance Grinding's GBP engagement rose 15%, a positive contrast worth watching. A set of CRM, outreach, and web milestones that were due between July and September remain open, and closing those is the direct path to restoring lead flow; work on those items is actively underway with an October 31 target across automation, SEO reindexing, and outreach sequences.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
organic search clicks to O'Hare Precision Metals in the last 28 days, the strongest search footprint of the three
week-over-week rise in Advance Grinding Services GBP engagement, the one channel moving in the right direction

watch_item.issue: Eight SOW milestones — spanning CRM setup, outreach sequences, and web SEO fixes — are past their July–September due dates, keeping paid lead generation and automated outreach offline.
watch_item.fix: All open items are targeted for completion by October 31: CRM automations, site reindexing, and the first outreach sequences are in motion now.
